caption:
Beans on Pav 🫘🍞🧀

Another dish added to Sunday brunch specials that comes together in under 10 minutes if you have leftover beans like I did :p 

1 packet pav ( 6 pieces together) 
1 tsp butter
2 tbsp per slice of my Mexican beans with a little paneer added #protein
Cheese as much as you desire 
Chopped green chillies 
One fried egg per slice because why not add more protein 😅
